title: Peas and carrots, canned, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Peas and carrots canned are a ready‑to‑eat vegetable mix that has been cooked and sealed in airtight jars without any added fat. The product retains most of the nutrients of the fresh vegetables and is convenient for quick meal preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Canning allows vegetables to be stored for several years while preserving flavor and color.
Peas are high in plant protein and fiber, while carrots provide provitamin A (beta‑carotene).
In many countries these cans are common in school meals and backpacking rations.
The jars are typically heat‑treated at 115 °C for 30‑45 minutes to ensure safety.

items.title: Rich source of plant protein
items.content: Peas deliver about 5 g of protein per 100 g, making them a good meat alternative for vegetarians.

items.title: Supports eye health
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots converts to vitamin A, essential for vision and immune function.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion, promotes satiety, and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes this product suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Peas contain vitamin B6 and folate, important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Canned vegetables are often salted for preservation; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to peas; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Bacterial safety
items.content: Bulging or damaged cans can indicate bacterial growth; such products should be discarded.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat straight from the jar: add it to soups, stews, salads, pasta, or serve as a side dish. It can be warmed briefly in the microwave or on the stovetop if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened jars in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the contents in a sealed container in the refrigerator and consume within 3‑4 days.
